questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: The correct statement(s) about the following sugar X and Y is(are)

options.content: X is a reducing sugar and Y is a non-reducing sugar.
X is a non-reducing sugar and Y is a reducing sugar.

questions.explanation: Reducing sugars contain cyclic hemiacetal or hemiketal groups in equilibrium with the open chain from having a free CHO or C = O group. Non-reducing sugars contain stable acetal or ketal structures their cyclic structures cannot be opened into an open chain form having a free carbonyl group. In X the glyco-sidic linkage is in between two anomeric carbon atoms while in Y it is only with one anomeric carbon, the other one is free. So, X is non-reducing while Y is reducing.
